headline: Bitcoin briefly fell to about $79,100 on Saturday as worries about a possible US strike on Iran forced out more than $800 million of leveraged bets, then climbed back above $80,000.

market.asOf: Read from The Block's market report at about 1:00pm ET (17:00 UTC) on Sat 24 Oct; this run could not open CoinGecko, so Solana and Fear & Greed are not shown. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: Not available this run (source could not be opened)

stories.title: Bitcoin dips to about $79,100, then gets back above $80,000
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 again on Saturday, touching about $79,146, before recovering above $80,000 by the afternoon in the US. The drop forced hundreds of millions of dollars of borrowed-money bets on rising prices to close. It came as tension between the US and Iran grew over the weekend.
points: Bitcoin.com reports a low of about $79,146 on Saturday and a recovery above $80,000 by 2:30pm ET.

In the four hours to 1pm ET, $436.44M of leveraged positions were liquidated (forcibly closed), $404.15M of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data cited by The Block. The 24-hour total was $815.26M.
Arthur Hayes said he closed out the directional trading book at his family office Maelstrom, citing macro and geopolitical risk, per The Block.
US Ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack said a strike on Iran could come "this weekend", per CBS News; Brent crude is about $117, its highest since April, per Al Jazeera.
The Fed decides on Wed 28 Oct at 2:00pm ET with rates at 3.75-4.00%.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost money two days running, but the week still ended up
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw money leave on Thursday and Friday. Strong buying earlier in the week means the week as a whole still ended with more money in than out. ETFs do not trade at weekends, so the next figures come after Monday's session.
points: Friday 23 Oct: -$137.94M, led by BlackRock's IBIT (-$110.34M) and Fidelity's FBTC (-$31.78M), per SoSoValue data cited by The Block.
Thursday 22 Oct: -$635.49M, per SoSoValue via The Block.
The week still ended at a net +$304.73M, and total bitcoin ETF assets are $104.43B, per The Block.
Ether ETFs took in $4.35M on Friday but lost $220.60M over the week, per The Block.

stories.title: Electrum bitcoin wallet users told to upgrade to version 4.8.3 now
stories.summary: The team behind Electrum, a popular bitcoin wallet, has fixed a flaw that let a malicious server swap a payment in a user's history for a fake one. If the user then raised the fee on it, the wallet could sign a payment to the attacker.
points: Versions before 4.8.3 are affected; users connected only to servers they trust are not, per Cryptonomist.
Developers had two user reports, one with real losses; in both, the attacker's address matched the last four characters of the intended one, per Cryptonomist.
Advice: upgrade, download only from electrum.org, check signatures, and check the whole address, including when raising a fee.

briefs.title: Circle shareholder's lawsuit against Trump: no ruling yet
briefs.summary: A Circle shareholder sued in federal court in Washington over UAE-linked crypto deals; Circle says it did not authorize the suit and the White House calls it frivolous, per Bitcoin.com.
